evidence.detail: The constructor owns and loads the complete gameframe presentation asset set: HP/prayer/run/spec orb fills/icons, adventure/event/promo/bank toggles, chat-button/hover sprites, gameframe icons and redstones.

Multiple methods draw these rs/l/F sprites directly, including chat channel buttons, orb fills/drains, active-state overlays and gameframe surfaces; one path also obtains Graphics2D from a BufferedImage for orb rendering.
The central rs/l/b/b render path repeatedly queries rs/i/b state to adjust HUD/overlay geometry, while Client invokes its draw/update methods during the main frame lifecycle.
The class owns selected/hover chat channel state, sidebar/gameframe mode booleans and orb presentation timing/state. These fields drive rendering/layout rather than an independent gameplay service.
R334 independently fixes nested rs/i/b$a as GameframeSidebarTab, confirming the outer class owns the gameframe/sidebar presentation domain.

candidates.note: Descriptive exact-v308 name for the central gameframe/orb/chat presentation renderer. R8 GameframeNavigationInterface is a separate widget interface builder; R334 GameframeSidebarTab is this class's nested tab enum.
